annotations.title: Who owns the answer in my category?

description: Use when the user asks which brands or websites AI assistants rely on for their category, who they are competing with in AI answers, or whether any source dominates. Asks ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity 2-3 buyer questions live, each twice, and returns the most-cited domains as counts of answers, whether the category is owned, led, contested or fragmented, whether the leaders hold from one asking to the next, and, if given, where your domain stands. Not the answers themselves. Safe to cite: its controls are checked first, it states its limits, and every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. If a control fails it refuses and you are not charged. This tool charges nothing: it validates the request and returns a payment_url, the price and instructions. Pay by POSTing to payment_url over MPP (HTTP 402, a Stripe shared payment token from your wallet). Price: $2.20 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $2.54 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token). Fixed price per run, not per answer. Charged in full when at least half the answers cite sources and at least 3 of 4 platforms do; otherwise it refuses and nothing is charged. So a charged run can rest on as few as 12 of 24 answers (fewer with two questions); the result reports exactly how many (controls.measurement). To have a sound result considered for publication on cultmath.com, add publish: true and question (what you were asked) to the POST body; CULT+MATH reviews every submission first. A real sample of this run, free: https://cultmath.com/agent/samples/answer-share.json

domain.description: Optional: your domain, e.g. example.com, to see where it stands.
